Our engineers become your engineers. We deploy alongside your team, adapting AI to your workflows and turning your priorities into production.

Bring documentation, coding, orders, chart intelligence, and clinical decision support into one platform, built to adapt to every provider, specialty, and workflow.

“I love the look of the Face Sheet — everything important from the EHR is on one page: past notes, active issues, comorbidities, treatment history, lab trend graphs, etc. It reads like an intelligent summary of what's going on with the patient.”

“In regards to [Knowtex's] recommended CPT and DX coding, it prompts them well based on the note and will only get smarter. It gives guidance that can be changed based on MDM or time, and helps to guide to the correct ICD-10. It does also guide past the unspecified diagnosis, which is what [providers] usually just put in there. So far I am impressed, and I do not advocate much for tech.”

“Knowtex significantly reduces the tremendous burden of admin work and improves wellness, which allows me to see more patients and generate more revenue. That remains how Knowtex operates.”

Knowtex develops proprietary specialty-specific models and AI harnesses, according to Zhang, and has “anti-hallucination safeguards” in place to ensure record accuracy. There is also evaluation science via embedded evaluators that “judge clinical AI the way a clinician would.”
